name: laptop-mockup
title: Laptop Mockup
description: An original desktop device frame with a dimensional screen, keyboard deck, and a flexible product-preview surface.
useWhen: You want to present a desktop product screen with more visual context than a flat image.
avoidWhen: Dense app content must remain fully readable at a small display size.
responsiveBehavior: The laptop remains centered and scales its frame down on smaller viewports while preserving the screen aspect ratio.
accessibility: Uses a descriptive label for the desktop product preview.
Keeps decorative hardware details out of the meaningful content flow.

variants.title: Studio laptop
variants.description: A polished, original laptop shell with an ambient stage and an adaptable desktop screen slot.
accessibility: Treat the hardware frame as decorative context.
Provide meaningful text alternatives for inserted product screenshots.
